task: Create a file src/utils/math.ts that exports four functions: add(a: number, b: number): number, subtract(a: number, b: number): number, multiply(a: number, b: number): number, and divide(a: number, b: number): number. The divide function must throw an Error if b is zero.

Create a file src/cache.ts implementing a generic LRUCache<K, V> class with methods: get(key), set(key, value), delete(key), has(key), clear(), and a size getter. The constructor takes a maxSize parameter. When capacity is exceeded, evict the least recently used entry.

Create two files: (1) src/types.ts defining interfaces for Todo (id: number, title: string, completed: boolean, createdAt: Date) and CreateTodoInput (title: string). (2) src/todo-store.ts implementing a TodoStore class with methods: add(input: CreateTodoInput): Todo, getById(id: number): Todo | undefined, getAll(): Todo[], update(id: number, fields: Partial<Todo>): Todo | null, delete(id: number): boolean, and findByStatus(completed: boolean): Todo[]. Use auto-incrementing IDs.

Create a file src/utils/strings.ts that exports these string utility functions: capitalize(s: string): string, camelCase(s: string): string, kebabCase(s: string): string, truncate(s: string, maxLen: number): string. Each function must handle edge cases like empty strings.

Create a file src/types.ts exporting these TypeScript utility types: DeepPartial<T> (makes all nested properties optional), Prettify<T> (flattens intersections for readability), PickByValue<T, V> (picks keys whose values extend V), and Optional<T, K extends keyof T> (makes specified keys optional). Each type must have a JSDoc comment explaining its purpose.

Create a file src/database.ts implementing a generic InMemoryDatabase<T extends { id: number }> class. Methods: insert(item: Omit<T, "id">): T (auto-increments id), findById(id: number): T | undefined, findAll(): T[], findWhere(predicate: (item: T) => boolean): T[], update(id: number, fields: Partial<T>): T | null, delete(id: number): boolean. The class must be generic and work with any type that has an id field.

Create a file src/retry.ts exporting an async function retry<T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, options?: { maxRetries?: number; delayMs?: number; backoff?: number }): Promise<T>. It must retry on failure with exponential backoff (delay doubles each attempt). Default: 3 retries, 1000ms initial delay, backoff factor 2.

Create a file src/errors.ts implementing an error class hierarchy: AppError (base class with code: string and message: string), ValidationError (extends AppError, adds field: string), NotFoundError (extends AppError, adds resource: string), and UnauthorizedError (extends AppError). Each must extend Error properly with correct prototype chain.

Create two files: (1) src/event-bus.ts implementing a typed EventEmitter class with on(event, handler), off(event, handler), emit(event, ...args), and once(event, handler) methods. (2) src/event-bus.test.ts with unit tests verifying subscribe, unsubscribe, emit, and once behavior. Use Node built-in assert module for tests.

Create a file src/utils/validators.ts exporting these validator functions: isEmail(s: string): boolean, isUrl(s: string): boolean, isPhoneNumber(s: string): boolean. Use single quotes, semicolons, trailing commas, and add a brief JSDoc comment above each function.

Create a file src/utils/dates.ts exporting: formatDate(d: Date, pattern: string): string, addDays(d: Date, n: number): Date, diffDays(a: Date, b: Date): number, isToday(d: Date): boolean. Use consistent formatting: single quotes, semicolons, proper spacing.

Create a file src/constants.ts organizing constants into logical groups using object literals: HTTP_STATUS (common status codes with names), CONTENT_TYPES (json, html, text, etc.), and ERROR_MESSAGES (notFound, unauthorized, validationFailed, internalError). Export each group. Use clean, well-organized formatting.

Create a file src/middleware/error-handler.ts exporting an Express-style error handling middleware function errorHandler(err, req, res, next). It must: log the error, return JSON with { error: message, code }, handle ValidationError and NotFoundError differently (400 vs 404), default to 500. Use clean formatting with JSDoc.

Create a file src/utils/arrays.ts exporting: unique<T>(arr: T[]): T[], chunk<T>(arr: T[], size: number): T[][], flatten<T>(arr: (T | T[])[]): T[], groupBy<T>(arr: T[], keyFn: (item: T) => string): Record<string, T[]>. Use consistent TypeScript generics and formatting.

Methods: pipe<U>(fn: (input: T) => Promise<U>): Pipeline<U>, execute(): Promise<T>, and a static create<T>(input: T): Pipeline<T> factory.
